definitions.explanation: A cord, string, or strap used to attach, tie, or fasten something. Commonly refers to the thong of a sandal or the chin strap of a hat.

examples.english: The thong of my wooden sandal broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草履|ぞうり}→草履：04048_zouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緒|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}える。
examples.english: I'll replace the strap on my zori sandals.
I tied the chin strap of the hat under my chin.

notes:
An old and fundamental Japanese word for a cord or strap used to fasten things. Most commonly encountered in connection with traditional Japanese footwear.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{鼻緒|はなお}→鼻緒：15379_hanao⟧: the thong/strap of a sandal (geta, zori, etc.)
- {帯緒|おびお}: a cord used to secure an obi
- {手綱|たづな}: reins (literally "hand cord")

USAGE:
- In modern Japanese, {緒|お} as a standalone word is somewhat literary or traditional
- The compound ⟦{鼻緒|はなお}→鼻緒：15379_hanao⟧ is the most common modern usage
- Also appears in the set expression ⟦{戦|いくさ}→戦：28574_ikusa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緒|お}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ — to enter battle

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緒|お}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: a strap breaks
- {緒|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to tie a cord
- {緒|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to attach a strap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧: string, cord — the general everyday word for any cord or string
- ⟦{鼻緒|はなお}→鼻緒：15379_hanao⟧: sandal thong — the most common compound using {緒|お}
- ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧: sash, belt — worn around the waist with kimono
